articles.title: BlackRock, Fidelity, other Wall Street giants back the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, Goldman Sachs and SoFi have publicly endorsed the crypto market structure bill as the Senate's timeline tightens.

articles.title: Ethereum startup EthSystems bets privacy is key to getting banks on public blockchains
articles.snippet: EthSystems, which spun out of the Ethereum Foundation earlier this month, is focused on building privacy infrastructure for banks and other financial institutions.

articles.title: Hong Kong’s central bank puts a number on lenders' quantum preparedness. It's very low.
articles.snippet: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority published a whitepaper on the quantum preparedness of Hong Kong’s banking industry and its first Quantum Preparedness Index.

articles.title: Core Scientific revenue doubles in Q2 as AI colocation expansion accelerates
articles.snippet: Core Scientific reported strong second-quarter revenue growth as AI colocation became its largest business, though a non-cash accounting charge resulted in a $1.15 billion net loss.

articles.title: Zcash Miner Fortitude Powers Up Nebraska Facility as It Eyes Public Listing
articles.snippet: The Digital Currency Group-owned Zcash miner brought its first greenfield site online as it looks to lower mining costs and advance plans to become a public company.
